versions.localizedDescription:
# What's New

## 📖 Reader & Manga

* **Intelligent Double-Page Spreads & RTL Reading** (#1018, #1008):
  * Wide and landscape double-page spreads are now shown seamlessly on their own full-width screen instead of being awkwardly paired with single pages.
  * Switching between single and double-page view, rotating your device, or changing reading modes no longer resets your progress back to chapter 1.
  * Resuming chapters in Right-to-Left (manga) reading mode now starts in the correct direction without layout flipping.
* **Instant Border Cropping & Cache Improvements**:
  * Turning border crop on or off in Webtoon / continuous reading now applies instantly without re-downloading the images.
  * Fixed an issue where resuming a chapter at a saved page could cause an infinite loading spinner for already cached images.
* **Smoother Reading Experience**:
  * Fixed page flickering and display glitches when scrolling quickly through continuous chapters.

---

## Novel Reader

* **Scroll-Free E-Reader Paged Mode** (#1019):
  * Read novels like a real book with page-turning swipes and taps instead of endless vertical scrolling.
  * Quickly switch between **Continuous Scroll** and **Paged Reading** directly from the novel settings sheet.
* **Single & Double-Page Column Layouts** (#1019):
  * Added single-page and side-by-side double-page reading modes, optimized for tablets, foldable devices, and landscape screens.
  * Settings sheet changes (reading mode, page mode) are now applied and previewed instantly.

---

## Video Player & Anime

* **Player Screen Lock (Mobile)**:
  * Added a dedicated screen lock button to the mobile controls to prevent accidental touches while watching.
  * When locked, all on-screen controls, touch gestures (swiping to seek, volume/brightness, double-tap jump, 2x speed hold), and the skip button are completely disabled.
  * Protects against accidentally exiting the player with the back button or back gesture.
  * Tap anywhere on the locked screen to display a quick-unlock button in the top-left corner.
* **Cleaner Seek Indicator**:
  * Simplified and streamlined the swipe-to-seek visual overlay on the player.

---

## Features & User Experience

* **Smoother Category Management**:
  * Reordering categories in settings is now much more responsive and intuitive using dedicated drag handles.
* **Details Header Polish**:
  * Improved visual layout and formatting in the manga/anime details header.

---

## Fixes & Stability

* **Reliable Background Sync**:
  * Fixed occasional crashes and errors that could occur when closing screens or navigating away during library synchronization.

---

## Localization

* Added translations for the new player screen lock feature across all supported languages.

---

## Contributors

* @kodjodevf
* @jikkun (#1018, #1019)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/compare/v0.9.5...v0.9.6
